title: The 1792 French Crown Jewels Theft
hook: Who stole France's priceless jewels during the Revolution?
headline: Mystery of the Missing French Crown Jewels

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On September eleven 1792 thieves broke into the Garde Meuble in Paris

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Four men, including a former royal valet, used a duplicate key

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: They vanished with gems valued at thirty million livres and escaped through a tunnel

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: The Hope diamond resurfaced in 1812, hinting at a Swiss smuggler per police reports

end.line: Who might have hidden the stolen treasure for centuries?

description: Explore the baffling 1792 theft of France's crown jewels and the clues that still puzzle historians.
